checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly labeled low-confidence; content review is eligible, while precise spatial conclusions remain prohibited.
Three required key areas are present as concept-only nodes; official polygons are still required before planning or engineering use.
Initial land-use polygons are derived from site boundary partitioning.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
Per-asset authorship, source clearance, font, dependency, transformation, license, attribution, and withdrawal rules are documented.
agent.1 through agent.6 are indexed to verifiable narrative, structured data, figures, HTML, and PDF outputs.
All twelve scenarios include triggers, minimum data, retention, RACI, non-AI alternatives, SLA, cost, maintenance, appeal, stop/recovery, and evaluation.
